notes: 28 new restaurant/deal candidates found via a 6-pass GPT discovery loop (stopped clean on a zero-result pass), then converted to deal-intake schema by a separate GPT worker. All rows are workflow_status=needs_review, none publish-eligible. dine_in/takeout/delivery service-mode flags were deliberately left blank by the conversion worker where the source evidence did not state them - see deal-intake.csv warnings from `npm run research:validate`. Companion files (restaurant-source-list, source-inventory, source-captures, review-tasks) were auto-derived from deal-intake.csv's own columns, not independently re-researched.
